project: Personal Trainer App - Client Feature Tests
description: Comprehensive test suite for client-facing features using devtool devbar with client role

test_suites.description: Test client login flow using magic link (without biometric)

tests.title: Access login screen as unauthenticated client
steps: 1. Kill app or logout to unauthenticated state
2. App should redirect to /login screen
3. Verify LoginScreen displays 'Send Magic Link' button
4. Email TextField should be empty and focused
tests.expected_result: LoginScreen renders with email input ready for entry

tests.title: Send magic link with client email
steps: 1. Enter valid client email in TextField
2. Tap 'Send Magic Link' button
3. Observe loading spinner while request is in flight
4. Wait for response from backend
tests.expected_result: Screen transitions to MagicLinkVerificationScreen, showing success message 'Check your email'

tests.title: Verify magic link code input
steps: 1. MagicLinkVerificationScreen should display email used
2. Code input field should show 6 placeholder slots
3. Keyboard should auto-open on screen load
4. Input 123456 (test code for dev mode)
tests.expected_result: Code field accepts input, auto-advances after 6 digits entered

tests.title: Verify biometric auth after code verification
steps: 1. After code verification succeeds, BiometricAuthScreen displays
2. Show 'Use Face ID/Touch ID to complete login' message
3. Verify biometric options available on device
4. Tap biometric auth button (or use device biometric)
tests.expected_result: Biometric prompt appears; on success navigates to /dashboard

test_suites.description: Test client login using dev token directly from devtool devbar

tests.title: Access devtool devbar with client role
steps: 1. Shake device to open dev menu (or long-press home on simulator)
2. Find 'DevDataSeeder' or 'Dev Tools' section in devbar
3. Locate 'Switch Role' option
4. Select 'client' from dropdown
tests.expected_result: Dev bar shows 'Current Role: client' with client dev token displayed

tests.title: Dev token automatically sets client session
steps: 1. After selecting client role in devbar, tap 'Apply' or 'Save'
2. App should automatically navigate away from login screen
3. AuthStateProvider should emit authenticated state with client user
4. Observe network logs showing authorization header with dev token
tests.expected_result: App navigates to /dashboard (client version), authStateProvider shows non-null client user

tests.title: Verify client profile endpoint returns user data
steps: 1. After authenticated as client, open DevTools network tab
2. Make request to GET /api/v1/auth/me
3. Verify response contains user_type='client'
4. Verify response contains client fields (email, name, trainer_id)
tests.expected_result: HTTP 200 response with user data: {user_type: 'client', email: '...', name: '...', trainer_id: '...'}

test_suites.description: Test client profile display and updates

tests.title: Display client own profile
steps: 1. Authenticate as client via devtool
2. Navigate to Profile tab/screen
3. Verify profile displays: avatar, name, email, trainer name
4. Verify trainer_id is displayed as link to trainer profile
tests.expected_result: Client profile screen shows all user information, trainer assigned correctly

tests.title: Client cannot access other clients' profiles
steps: 1. While logged in as client 1, attempt to navigate to /clients/{other_client_id}
2. Send GET request via network tab: /api/v1/clients/{other_client_id}
3. Observe response status code
tests.expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden response, client blocked from viewing other clients

tests.title: Client can view assigned trainer profile
steps: 1. From client profile, tap on trainer name/photo
2. Navigate to trainer profile screen
3. Verify trainer information displays: name, bio, experience, photos
4. Verify contact button available (call/message)
tests.expected_result: Trainer profile screen loads and displays trainer data

test_suites.description: Test client viewing and interacting with assigned workouts

tests.title: View assigned workouts list
steps: 1. Authenticate as client via devtool
2. Navigate to Workouts tab
3. Observe GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/workouts request
4. Verify list displays assigned workouts with trainer name
tests.expected_result: Workouts list loads and displays all workouts assigned by trainer

tests.title: View workout details (exercises, instructions)
steps: 1. Tap on workout from list
2. Workout detail screen opens
3. Verify displays: name, description, exercises, sets/reps, instructions
4. Verify 'Mark as Complete' button available at bottom
tests.expected_result: Workout detail screen loads with all exercise information

tests.title: Client can mark workout complete (offline-first)
steps: 1. Open workout detail screen
2. Tap 'Mark as Complete' button
3. App should save locally first (verify in Drift database)
4. If online: POST to /api/v1/workouts/{id}/complete
5. If offline: Mark with isSynced=false, show 'Syncing...' indicator
tests.expected_result: Workout marked as complete locally, sync status shown in UI

tests.title: View workout completion history
steps: 1. Navigate to Progress or History tab
2. Verify list shows completed workouts with dates
3. Tap on completed workout to view completion details
4. Verify shows completion date, duration, notes from trainer
tests.expected_result: History/Progress screen displays all completed workouts chronologically

test_suites.description: Test client progress visualization and metrics

tests.title: View progress dashboard
steps: 1. Authenticate as client with completed workouts
2. Navigate to Progress or Dashboard tab
3. Verify displays metrics cards: workouts completed, progress streak, etc.
4. Verify GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/progress loads data
tests.expected_result: Progress dashboard displays with all tracked metrics

tests.title: View progress charts (if implemented)
steps: 1. On progress screen, verify charts render correctly
2. Charts should show: workout frequency, completion rate, consistency
3. Tap on chart to view detailed breakdown
tests.expected_result: Charts display workout progress trends, no crashes

tests.title: Log custom measurements (weight, photos)
steps: 1. Locate 'Log Measurement' or 'Update Progress' button
2. Enter measurement value (e.g., weight in lbs/kg)
3. Optionally attach photo from camera/gallery
4. Tap 'Save' to submit
tests.expected_result: Measurement saved locally, synced to server when online

tests.title: View messages from trainer
steps: 1. Navigate to Messages tab
2. Verify conversation list shows trainer name
3. Tap conversation to open chat
4. Verify messages display with timestamps and read receipts
tests.expected_result: Messages screen loads with conversation history

tests.title: Send message to trainer
steps: 1. Open trainer conversation
2. Type message in text input field
3. Tap Send button
4. Verify message appears in conversation locally (optimistic update)
5. Verify POST request sent to /api/v1/messages
tests.expected_result: Message sent and appears in conversation, sync status updated

tests.title: Receive push notifications (FCM)
steps: 1. Have trainer send message in separate session
2. Verify push notification appears on client device
3. Tap notification to navigate to message thread
4. Verify new message is fetched and displayed
tests.expected_result: Push notification received and in-app navigation works

tests.title: Message persistence (offline sync)
steps: 1. Disable internet (airplane mode or dev tools network throttle)
2. Send message to trainer
3. Verify message saved locally with isSynced=false
4. Re-enable internet, observe sync
5. Verify message delivered after sync
tests.expected_result: Message persists offline, syncs when online restored

test_suites.description: Test client payment and subscription functionality

tests.title: View subscription status
steps: 1. Navigate to Subscription or Billing tab
2. Verify subscription status displays (active, trialing, cancelled)
3. Verify displays: plan name, price, renewal date
4. Verify GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/subscription returns data
tests.expected_result: Subscription screen shows current status and plan details

tests.title: Purchase premium workout pack
steps: 1. Navigate to Store or Available Workouts
2. Find premium workout package with price
3. Tap 'Buy' or 'Add to Cart' button
4. Stripe payment sheet should open
tests.expected_result: Stripe payment sheet initializes with purchase details

tests.title: Complete payment with test card (Stripe)
steps: 1. In Stripe payment sheet, enter test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242
2. Enter expiry 12/34 and CVC 123
3. Tap 'Pay' button
4. Verify loading state and payment processing
tests.expected_result: Payment succeeds, navigates back to app, workout unlocked

tests.title: Handle payment failure gracefully
steps: 1. Attempt purchase with declined test card: 4000 0000 0000 0002
2. Observe error message in Stripe sheet
3. Verify error is logged with payment intent ID
4. Verify 'Retry' button available to user
tests.expected_result: Payment error handled gracefully, user can retry

test_suites.description: Test client app settings and preferences

tests.title: Access settings screen
steps: 1. Navigate to Settings or Profile menu
2. Verify Settings screen displays
3. Verify sections: Account, Notifications, Privacy, About
tests.expected_result: Settings screen loads with all configuration options

tests.title: Toggle notification preferences
steps: 1. In Settings, find Notifications section
2. Toggle 'Workout Reminders' switch
3. Toggle 'Messages' switch
4. Observe changes saved to backend
tests.expected_result: Notification preferences saved, verified in GET /api/v1/clients/{id}

tests.title: Change theme (light/dark/system)
steps: 1. In Settings, find Theme option
2. Tap theme selector
3. Choose 'Dark' theme
4. Verify UI immediately updates to dark colors
tests.expected_result: Theme changes immediately, persists in SharedPreferences

tests.title: Export personal data
steps: 1. In Settings, find 'Export Data' option
2. Tap 'Download My Data'
3. Verify GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/export endpoint called
4. Data file downloaded (JSON with profile, workouts, payments)
tests.expected_result: Data exported successfully as JSON file

tests.title: Logout client session
steps: 1. In Settings, tap 'Logout' button
2. Confirm logout in dialog
3. Verify tokens cleared from flutter_secure_storage
4. Verify app redirects to /login screen
tests.expected_result: Session cleared, app returns to login screen

tests.title: Delete account (with confirmation)
steps: 1. In Settings, find 'Delete Account' option
2. Tap and confirm deletion dialog
3. Verify DELETE /api/v1/clients/{id} request sent
4. Observe app redirects to login after deletion
tests.expected_result: Account deletion confirmed, user logged out

test_suites.description: Test offline-first sync and local persistence

tests.title: App works in airplane mode
steps: 1. Enable Airplane Mode or disable WiFi/cellular
2. Attempt to navigate between screens
3. View locally cached workouts
4. Mark workout complete (saves locally with isSynced=false)
tests.expected_result: App functions normally, no crashes, local actions persist

tests.title: Sync queue tracks pending changes
steps: 1. While offline, complete workout and send message
2. Use DevTools to inspect Drift database
3. Verify both actions have isSynced=false
4. Check sync_queue table has entries for both
tests.expected_result: Pending changes tracked in Drift, ready to sync when online

tests.title: Automatic sync when connectivity restored
steps: 1. While offline, complete 2-3 workouts
2. Disable Airplane Mode to restore connectivity
3. Observe SyncService triggers sync (should happen in 5 min max)
4. Verify in network tab: POST requests for each pending action
tests.expected_result: All pending changes synced automatically, isSynced set to true

tests.title: Handle sync conflicts gracefully
steps: 1. Offline: Mark workout as complete
2. Meanwhile, trainer cancels workout on server
3. Restore connectivity and trigger sync
4. Observe conflict resolution (last-write-wins or manual resolution)
tests.expected_result: Sync completes, conflict resolved without data loss

test_suites.description: Test app performance, error handling, and edge cases

tests.title: Handle network errors gracefully
steps: 1. While loading workout list, kill backend or simulate 500 error
2. Observe error message displayed in UI
3. Verify 'Retry' button available
4. Restore backend and tap Retry
tests.expected_result: Error shown in UI, retry succeeds after fix

tests.title: Handle 401 unauthorized (token expired)
steps: 1. Revoke/expire client token on backend
2. Make any request (e.g., fetch workouts)
3. App should detect 401 and redirect to login
4. Verify AuthStateProvider invalidated
tests.expected_result: App redirects to login, session cleared

tests.title: Image caching performance
steps: 1. Load workout list with trainer avatar images
2. Scroll up and down multiple times
3. Monitor memory and network usage in DevTools
4. Verify images use CachedNetworkImage with size limits
tests.expected_result: Images load fast on second scroll, no excessive network requests

tests.title: List pagination (if workouts > 20)
steps: 1. With many workouts assigned, load workout list
2. Verify only 20 items load initially
3. Scroll to bottom to trigger pagination
4. Verify next 20 items load without full refresh
tests.expected_result: Pagination works smoothly, no loading freezes

tests.title: Handle large data sets (100+ workouts)
steps: 1. Via backend, assign 100+ workouts to test client
2. Load app and navigate to Workouts list
3. Verify app doesn't crash or become unresponsive
4. Search/filter workouts by name
tests.expected_result: App handles large datasets, remains performant

test_suites.description: Test client security and authorization controls

tests.title: Client cannot access trainer endpoints
steps: 1. Authenticate as client with dev token
2. Attempt GET /api/v1/trainer/clients (trainer-only endpoint)
3. Verify 403 Forbidden response
tests.expected_result: Backend rejects trainer-only endpoint for client role

tests.title: Client tokens stored securely
steps: 1. After login, verify token stored in flutter_secure_storage
2. Use DevTools to inspect Dart code, verify SecureStorage import
3. Verify NO token in SharedPreferences (grep for token)
4. Token should NOT appear in console logs
tests.expected_result: Tokens stored in secure storage, not visible in logs/prefs

tests.title: Authorization header present in all requests
steps: 1. Authenticate as client
2. Make any API request (fetch workouts, send message, etc.)
3. In network tab, verify request has: Authorization: Bearer <token>
4. Check AuthInterceptor is working (add debug log)
tests.expected_result: All requests include valid Authorization header

tests.title: Biometric auth enforced on login
steps: 1. Verify biometric is MANDATORY in flow (not optional)
2. After code verification, BiometricAuthScreen must appear
3. Attempt to bypass by navigating directly to dashboard (should fail)
4. Verify token only issued after biometric success
tests.expected_result: Biometric is enforced, cannot skip or bypass

test_suites.description: Test client UI, navigation flow, and user experience

tests.title: Navigation between main tabs works smoothly
steps: 1. From dashboard, tap each main tab: Workouts, Progress, Messages, Profile
2. Verify each screen loads without errors
3. Tap back button, verify navigation history respected
4. Verify current tab indicator highlighted
tests.expected_result: Tab navigation fluid, no crashes, correct tab highlighted

tests.title: Loading states show spinners/skeletons
steps: 1. Load workout list, observe loading state
2. Use network throttle in DevTools to simulate slow network
3. Verify loading indicator appears while fetching
4. Once loaded, loading indicator disappears
tests.expected_result: Loading states visible to user, no blank screens

tests.title: App follows design system (colors, typography, spacing)
steps: 1. Navigate through app screens
2. Verify colors match design-system.md (lavender, purple, green)
3. Verify typography: Headlines 24px bold, Body 16px regular
4. Verify spacing consistent (8px grid system)
tests.expected_result: App matches design system specifications

tests.title: App responsive on different screen sizes
steps: 1. Test on small phone (320px width)
2. Test on large tablet (1024px width)
3. Verify layout adapts without overflow
4. Verify buttons/text still readable on all sizes
tests.expected_result: App responsive, works on all device sizes

accessing_devbar: iOS Simulator: Shake device or Cmd+Ctrl+Z
Android Emulator: Shake emulator or Ctrl+M (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+M (Windows/Linux)
switching_to_client_role: 5. Tap 'Apply' - app auto-logs in with dev client token
network_inspection: Use Flutter DevTools Network tab to inspect requests
Verify Authorization header present in all requests
database_inspection: Use Flutter DevTools Storage tab to inspect Drift database
Look for tables: users, clients, workouts, sync_queue, messages
Verify isSynced flag on offline changes

test_execution_notes: Run tests in debug mode using main_dev.dart (automatically loads DevDataSeeder)
Each test should be independent; can be run in any order
Mark test as 'passes': true only after MANUALLY executing all steps and verifying result
Network logs essential for API tests
Database inspection critical for offline sync tests
Always test both online and offline modes
Test on iOS and Android for comprehensive coverage

common_issues.issue: Dev token not working after role switch
common_issues.solution: Kill and restart app, ensure main_dev.dart is running, check DevDataSeeder in devbar
Verify AuthInterceptor is added to Dio, check flutter_secure_storage has token, restart app
Check SyncService is running (background worker), verify isSynced flag on local changes, manually trigger sync or wait 5 minutes

common_issues.issue: Biometric prompt not appearing after code verification
common_issues.solution: Check BiometricAuthScreen is in navigation flow, verify local_auth package permissions granted, check iOS entitlements
Verify CachedNetworkImage used instead of Image.network, check memCacheWidth/maxWidthDiskCache set, clear cache with app restart
